pages.text: Transmutation Scrolls are an alchemist's central tools. They turn knowledge of essence relations into two arts: $(term)Alchemical Replication$() and $(term)Alchemical Transformation$().

pages.title: Two Kinds of Scrolls
pages.text: Scrolls come in two kinds:$(li)$(term)Sigil Scrolls$(): for Alchemical Replication—use one item as a template to produce a new copy.$(li)$(term)Equation Scrolls$(): for Alchemical Transformation—transform one item into another.

pages.title: Five Tiers
pages.text: $(li)Transmutation: 50 durability; expires at noon.$(li)Terrestrial: 150; expires at noon.$(li)Lunar: 300; expires at new-moon midnight.$(li)Solar: 500; never expires.$(li)Void: unbreakable; never expires.

pages.title: Base Scrolls
pages.text: Both use an essence, crystal, paper, and gold nugget. Sigils add glowstone; equations add redstone.

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: Right-click while holding a blank scroll. For a Sigil, place the item you want to replicate in the right slot. For an Equation, place the input you want to transform in the left slot. If a matching recipe exists, the item is consumed and the scroll activates.

pages.title: Read Before Sealing
pages.text: $(warn)The placed item cannot be recovered after activation.$()$(br2)The activated interface previews the other side of the recipe and shows essences required by the recipe, which are hidden as question marks initially. A higher recipe level means more essences.
